text:
sara_sales: Hey team, mid-market POC -> customer hits 401 when using project-scoped key. Works with org-scoped, fails when they switch to project. Need quick triage, demo tomorrow.

alex_se: Can you paste the failing curl and the exact error? 401 message body usually has the reason.

sara_sales: Error body: "{\"error\":\"invalid_key\",\"detail\":\"key not bound to project\"}"
Curl they ran: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_project_ABC123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rlhf-v2","input":"hi"}'
```

jamal_support: That looks like a binding issue. Did they create the key under a different project or reuse an org-level key? Project-scoped keys have a binding to project_id in the control plane.

maria_eng: Quick checks: 1) call our key-lookup endpoint to confirm binding 2) check org_id in request headers (we tolerate either header or token-only binding depending on config) 3) confirm token hasn't been rotated.

alex_se: How can they call lookup? Give me the exact command to send to customer.

maria_eng: Use: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_project_ABC123" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/internal/keys/lookup
```
Response will include: `binding_type`, `project_id`, `scopes`.

olivia_sre: Also check rate-limit headers — if they were hitting 429 then retry logic can mask as other errors, but here it's a 401 so less likely. Still worth confirming logs on our side: I've pulled the proxy logs for that key (searching last 2 hours).

deploy-bot: [deploy] prod/control-plane updated key-binding service at 2026-05-12T14:02Z (v2.1.9) :white_check_mark:

jamal_support: Sara, if lookup shows `project_id: null` then the key is org-level or mis-provisioned. If it shows different project_id than the customer's POC project, that's the mismatch.

sara_sales: Customer did the lookup and got {"binding_type":"project","project_id":"proj-987","scopes":["generate","embeddings"]} but their POC app is under `proj-123`. They say they created the key in the console under proj-123 though.

maria_eng: Hm could be UI bug where console drops project context during key creation. Can you capture the creation request id from their audit logs? We log `create_key` events with `request_id`.

alex_se: I asked for audit export, they attached a CSV showing `request_id: r_20260512_9a2b`.

maria_eng: Good. Jamal/Olivia can you search the control plane audit for that request_id? If console created under wrong project, we need rollback + inform customer + offer to reissue key and update POC.

olivia_sre: Found it: `r_20260512_9a2b` shows create_key -> `project_id: proj-987`. Looks like console context was proj-987 for that session.

jamal_support: Next step for customer: reissue a new project-scoped key under proj-123 and rotate in their POC app. Short-term we can whitelist the existing key to proj-123 for demo if security ok. Security will need approval.

sara_sales: Customer asks about pricing impact if we reissue vs whitelist — they have budgeting constraints for demo. Any guidance?

alex_se: No pricing change for reissue. Whitelisting is an operational exception (no cost change either) but requires security sign-off. Reissue is faster and safer. Recommend reissue.

maria_eng: For the reissue advise: console -> Project Settings -> API Keys -> Create (ensure project dropdown shows proj-123) -> copy key and rotate. We can also do server-side rotate if they give us request_id.

jamal_support: I can support the rotation with them in the next 30m. Sara, want me to jump into the call?

sara_sales: Yes please, 15:30 PT. I'll DM dial-in. Also they asked about scopes: their key had `embeddings` scope but not `rerank`, so they got permission errors when calling the rerank endpoint earlier.

maria_eng: Good catch — verify all endpoints used by POC are included in the `scopes` array. If they need both generate+rerank+embeddings use `scopes:["generate","rerank","embeddings"]`.

olivia_sre: After rotation I'll add a short runbook note to prevent console context leakage. Also adding a small guard in UI to show `project` badge when creating keys.

sara_sales: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Jamal, connect with customer and confirm reissue completes. If security requires whitelist for demo, escalate to sec@redwood.

jamal_support: On it — I'll post a quick status update once done. :thumbsup:
